# CP-G1-STAND-02: BIMANUAL standing reach under GRAVITY (drive-based, no cuRobo). Reuses CP-G1-STAND-01's
# PROVEN root-weld FixedJoint(world->pelvis) fixed base, then drives BOTH arms (left + right shoulder_pitch +
# elbow) toward two cubes. Proof = BOTH arms' DOFs in eyes.json row['j'] ramp to targets AND the pelvis stays
# up (direct measure: head/torso above ground). A step toward bimanual humanoid manipulation; the clean dex
# grasp (16 finger DOFs) + cuRobo bimanual remain rung 2b.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", prim_type="DomeLight")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", attr_name="inputs:intensity", value=1000.0)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Ground", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, -0.5], scale=[20, 20, 1])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Ground", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
set_physics_scene_config(config={"enable_gpu_dynamics": True, "gravity_magnitude": 9.81, "gravity_direction": [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]})

create_prim(prim_path="/World/G1", prim_type="Xform", position=[0.0, 0.0, 0.793])
add_reference(prim_path="/World/G1", reference_path="/mnt/shared_data/isaac-sim-assets-complete-5.0.0/Assets/Isaac/5.0/Isaac/Samples/Groot/Robots/g1_29dof_with_hand_rev_1_0.usd")

# Root-weld (the proven fixed base, CP-G1-STAND-01).
run_usd_script(code="import omni.usd\nfrom pxr import UsdPhysics, UsdGeom, Usd, Sdf, Gf\nstage = omni.usd.get_context().get_stage()\npelvis = stage.GetPrimAtPath('/World/G1/pelvis')\nif not pelvis.IsValid():\n    print('STAND: ERROR pelvis missing at /World/G1/pelvis')\nelse:\n    m = UsdGeom.Xformable(pelvis).ComputeLocalToWorldTransform(Usd.TimeCode.Default())\n    pos = m.ExtractTranslation()\n    rot = m.ExtractRotationQuat()\n    fj = UsdPhysics.FixedJoint.Define(stage, '/World/G1_RootWeld')\n    fj.GetBody1Rel().SetTargets([Sdf.Path('/World/G1/pelvis')])\n    fj.CreateLocalPos0Attr(Gf.Vec3f(float(pos[0]), float(pos[1]), float(pos[2])))\n    fj.CreateLocalRot0Attr(Gf.Quatf(float(rot.GetReal()), Gf.Vec3f(*[float(x) for x in rot.GetImaginary()])))\n    fj.CreateLocalPos1Attr(Gf.Vec3f(0.0, 0.0, 0.0))\n    fj.CreateLocalRot1Attr(Gf.Quatf(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0))\n    print('STAND: root-weld FixedJoint world->pelvis at ' + str([round(float(x), 3) for x in pos]))\n", description="Root-weld the G1 (FixedJoint world->pelvis) so it stands under gravity")

# Two pedestals + cubes, one per hand (left at +y, right at -y), inside each arm's reach envelope.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/PedestalL", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.30, 0.18, 0.405], scale=[0.06, 0.06, 0.41])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/PedestalL", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
create_prim(prim_path="/World/PedestalR", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.30, -0.18, 0.405], scale=[0.06, 0.06, 0.41])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/PedestalR", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.30, 0.18, 0.87], size=0.05)
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name="PhysicsRigidBodyAPI")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_2", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.30, -0.18, 0.87], size=0.05)
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_2", schema_name="PhysicsRigidBodyAPI")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_2", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

# DRIVE BOTH ARMS (degrees). LEFT (proven in CP-G1-STAND-01) + RIGHT (mirror; pxr-verified nested paths).
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/G1/torso_link/left_shoulder_pitch_joint", attr_name="drive:angular:physics:targetPosition", value=50.0)
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/G1/left_shoulder_yaw_link/left_elbow_joint", attr_name="drive:angular:physics:targetPosition", value=60.0)
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/G1/torso_link/right_shoulder_pitch_joint", attr_name="drive:angular:physics:targetPosition", value=50.0)
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/G1/right_shoulder_yaw_link/right_elbow_joint", attr_name="drive:angular:physics:targetPosition", value=60.0)
